name: Yard Sweep
description: The yard is crawling with Scavs again. Thin them out, five of them, and walk back out so I know you can.
success: Quieter already. My drivers thank you, in their way.

name: Clean Shot
description: Spraying is for conscripts. Three Scavs on the yard, each dropped by a shot to the head. Then we talk.
success: Three for three. Keep that hand steady.

name: Krane's Yard
description: Krane thinks the yard is his. Put him down, and one of his guards with him, and get out alive to tell me.
success: So the crane finally fell. The yard is ours again.

name: Signal Check
description: Take this beacon and set it in the signal hut on the yard. Hold it in place till it locks on. Then walk the crossroads so I can calibrate.
success: Clean signal. Your beacon's still pinging, good work.

name: Dead Drop
description: A friend at the factory smokes my brand. Leave a pack of cigarettes at the west yard gate, and don't let anyone see you do it.
success: He says thank you. He also says you walk loud.

name: Factory Walk
description: Before I send nurses to the factory I want to know two rooms are still standing: the med bay and the overseer's office. Then leave by Gate 3, it's the way they'll come.
success: Still standing. Good. Fewer surprises for my people.

name: Carry Out
description: Find a Salewa out there and bring it back out of the factory on you. Keep it, I only need proof they're still on the shelves.
success: Sealed and dated. Someone's still stocking that place.

name: Trusted Hands
description: Earn my trust, then show me you can work: a surgical kit from your own Medstation.
success: Neat stitches on the packaging. You'll do. My suppliers will sell you Hawkeye now.

name: Bench Time
description: A real workshop needs a real bench. Build yours to level 2 and make me one set of weapon parts on it.
success: Proper bench, proper parts. I'll show you a shortcut for those.

name: Range Day
description: I tuned an AK-74N for a client and he wants proof it shoots. Five kills with one, any map, and stand back a bit for two of them: twenty metres.
success: Groups like a dream. The client will pay double.

name: Night Shift
description: Run your lavatory for me: two batches of anything from it. And grow up a little first, I don't trade with rookies.

name: Long Watch
description: Three PMCs at the factory, taken from thirty metres or more, and you get out with the story intact. I sell the tapes, you see.
success: The tape is beautiful. Grainy, but beautiful.
